entity_raw.definition_raw:
When you slay enemies, you frighten other opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Intimidating Prowess, worshiper of an evil deity.

Benefit(s): Upon reducing an enemy to 0 or fewer hit points, for the remaining duration of the combat encounter, you gain a +4 bonus on any Intimidate checks made to demoralize opponents who can see both you and the opponent you dropped.
